scope: Separate resource diagnostics; never substitute for unprofiled application or blocked-control acceptance
workload: Exact frozen main73 six FULL cases; providers emit through normal ingestion; each role gets fresh owned data and complete drainage
design: Five independent matched blocks. Each contains one full run of each role. Reverse the three-role order in alternating blocks. Each contrast thus has five alternating-order matched pairs. The same role observation is explicitly shared across contrasts within its block; do not count those contrasts as independent extra trials.
roleRegistration: B0/B1 exact frozen source/build receipts. B2 exact reviewed candidate/source/build/native/pins frozen before its first resource comparison; current qualified75 is the only registered candidate. Never retarget completed candidate captures.
prerequisites: Exact source and independent review pass
One SMALL actual serving qualification exercises all six hooks, correct SQL/postmaster binding, independent final flush, normal functional oracle and complete cleanup
Immutable counter definitions and identical instrumentation/topology/resource limits for all roles
Quiet host between invocations; no competing builds/profiles/benchmarks; finite owner and actual guard readback
captureRules: Keep all failures, retries, timeouts, ineligible windows and cleanup failures; never silently replace a trial
Use frozen terminal and independent verified-drain windows separately
Use at least six interior samples and at most10% numerator boundary uncertainty exactly as fixed definitions require
Report raw counters with ineligibility reasons for short/Stop windows; no invented ratios

Primary fixed workload denominator: independently verified unique committed text deltas, including all background/recovery/observer cost in numerator; show normalized-event/postcommit/transaction counts separately
Report five samples per role/contrast, absolute values, medians, spread and paired percentage bounds; no p99 from five run-level ratios
Bound CPU/event from cumulative-counter interval bounds; proc process CPU remains lowerbound-only; whole-PG cgroup CPU includes SQL observer
Keep observer overhead explicit; diagnostic timings do not establish application gains or replace original-SLA proof
Do not claim CPU improvement beyond a certified CPU-specific noise envelope when no such calibration exists; publish measured resource costs/tradeoffs with repeat spread and boundaries
